answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the ripple binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The cedar explorer exposes the whole merge tree. A 485 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
